         It gives me immense pleasure in welcoming you to
NAKACHARI COLLEGE which has been empowering students since
last three decades.

        Established with the efforts of a few local educationists and the
public support in the year 1988, the college provides facilities in three
years B.A. Course in Six Semester. Moreover, the college provides Three
Year Degree Courses and Master Degree course in different subjects
under the Directorate of distance education, Dibrugarh University and
different courses under KKHSOU. The college is affiliated to Dibrugarh University and recognized by
the Govt. of Assam. The Govt. of Assam has allotted 45 Bighas of land to the college in 1996. The
college also recognized by the University Grants Commission under Section 2(f) & 12(B) of the UGC
Act, 1956 vide letter No-8-476/2010 (CPP-I/C) dated 21-07-2011. The College has been Accredited by
NAAC in 2023.

        Situated away from din and bustle, the college is bestowed with natural beauty and it has a
tea planted area of about 32 Bighas of land. The panoramic view of the entire area of college is quite
greenery and peace and tranquility of this area attracts any one which is quite rare in the world of
advanced science and technology. Apart from imparting facilities for general courses of studies, the
College has introduced diversified courses to aware the pupils for self employment.

          Besides the facilities of academic enhancement, different platforms are available to express
your literary and academic creativity through the college magazine ANUBHUTI as well as through
various departmental news-letters, wall magazine etc. For the all round development of the students -
literary, cultural and sports facilities are available.

        We assure you that the college will provide all possible opportunities and help for enhancing
your personality as cultured, civilized and confident so as to cope with todays competitive world.

      We look forward to having you with us and hope that the time you spend with us would be
memorable.

       Welcome to Nakachari College once again.




                                                                                    Uttam Baruah
                                                                                      Principal

                                       INTRODUCTION

       Established with effort of a few local educationists and the public support in 1988,
Nakachari College provides facilities in Degree Courses in Arts Stream. Situated away from din
and bustle, the college is bestowed with natural beauty and it has a tea planted area of about 32
Bighas of land. Apart from imparting facilities for general courses of studies, the College is
awaiting for to introduce diversified courses to aware the pupils for self employment and at the
same time help the college to stride towards self sufficiency in the long run.

       The College is affiliated to Dibrugarh University and recognised by the Govt. of Assam.
The college also recognized by the University Grants Commission under Section 2(f) & 12(B) of
the UGC Act, 1956 vide letter No-8-476/2010 (CPP-I/C) dated 21-07-2011.

                                      INFRASTRUCTURE

         In a plot of land measuring 13 bighas with fencing around and ornamental plantation
welcome the college goers through Late Luit Kakoty memorial Gate. With an Administrative
building, the college is equipped with class rooms, common rooms, auditorium, sanitary
facilities, electrification etc. In the college Master Plan facilities for games and sports, computer
education, running water and the like are included which are on the way to materialise.

                        GENERAL RULES FOR DISCIPLINE
& The college expects its students to conduct themselves in a disciplined and dignified
manner in the college and outside . All students are expected to abide by rules to maintain an
academic and healthy environment in the college .
&       A student will be liable for disciplinary action for violation of rules, irregular clearance
of college fees, showing discourtesy to the teachers and staff members or any of the rules of
discipline. Students must maintain discipline and decorum in the college .
&       Mobile phones are not to be used in the college premises. Mobile phone will be
confiscated if used in the college or classrooms during study hour.
&       During free time students should not roam around in the corridors.
&       Writing of graffiti on the walls and pasting of posters is strictly prohibited and defaulters
will be fined. Any notice required to be pasted or circulated by student anywhere and in the
college premises shall have prior approval of the principal.
&       All waste materials should be thrown in the dustbins.
&      The college offers a full-time course. No students are allowed to pursue any other full-
time course concurrently.
&       For the purpose of intimating students about various college matters, notice is displayed
on the student notice board. Students must see the notice board daily.


    ADMISSION REQUIREMENT AND PROCEDURE FOR ADMISSION
        Application for admission into the college should be made on the website
http://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in and hard copy (printout copy of application form) is to be
submitted in the college.

FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO STUDENTS :
¾ Partial or full fee concession may be granted to the economically weak students.
Application for fee concession must be submitted on the prescribed form obtainable from the

 college office, duly supported by income certificate attested by the gazetted officer. The
application complete in all respects must be submitted to the college office prior to the date of
admission.
¾ Fee concession granted are subject to good conduct, regular attendance and satisfactory
progress in studies and may be withdrawn any time if a student is found neglecting any of these.

¾ SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/Minority and Meritorious Students are awarded Post-matric/ISHAN
UDAY scholarships by the Government through NSP. Students have to submit printout copy of
online submitted form in the college office along with necessary certificates/documents.
¾ Notice of scholarships granted by Govt. of Assam or other agencies are displayed on the
college Notice Board from time to time as and when they are received.
